comment: Phase 4 aims to transition from external funding to domestic financing. This may not be realistic or necessary in every setting, especially for regional services or long-term pooled financing.

public.text: Phase 4 aims to transition from external funding to domestic financing. This may not be realistic or necessary in every setting, especially for regional services or long-term pooled financing.
